scenes.title: CUHK MPIL Room 303 Optical Bay

scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory page and its installed apparatus photograph reviewed. Aluminium extrusion frames span above the tables and carry cables and power distribution. Monitors stand within the optical bay; an aisle follows the right edge beside blue-framed side benches.
